global: This is spicy ramen with a rich, deep red broth. Topped with chashu pork, shredded cabbage, green onions, and bean sprouts, it sits in a white bowl with blue floral patterns, under warm, ambient lighting on a wooden table.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black floral pattern and Japanese text, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved rim.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green onions, bean sprouts, and red chili threads, glistening under warm light.
regions.spoon: A pale green spoon with a smooth, glossy surface and a slightly curved, tapered shape.
regions.chopsticks: White chopsticks, smooth and slender, lie diagonally with slight wear visible on their surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows golden-brown seared exterior, tender white interior, and slight fat marbling.
